method_note: BEFORE = engine/m4/reports/live-turn-report-<w>-2026-10-13-eleven-world-test.json on origin/main (5b6f25060). AFTER = scratchpad live11c (rzg pahc syr alx desert) and live11b (ijc hal). Claims checked against records/<w>/ on origin/main; AFTER packages are 13-14 Oct builds. Rhythm uses engine.prose.quote_aware_sentences with the [a-z]+ word count from engine/m4/tests/live11_replay.rhythm; mean and sd are averaged per reply over 6 replies. Figures with placed-quote sentences excluded are also given, because a 90-117-word placed quote inflates both. FK/FRE come from engine.m7.turn_readability.score_turn. Quotes 'named' uses the slice's rule: the marker's own sentence names the speaker. No model calls.

syr_year_500: What happened: syr Q5 ('Tell me about someone who lived this out') shipped 'Later people said he founded and led the women's choirs himself, but that tradition appears only around 500 - generations after he died.' The engine's live horizon check (engine/m4/output_check.check_horizon, run in engine/m4/turn.py) flagged it, but that check only reports; it does not block. The claim is accurate and properly framed. syr.story.choirs-tradition is Tier 3 later memory (Jacob of Serug's memra, c. 500), its tellable_as says to tell it 'as later memory and not as fact from our own time', and the voice kept the two layers apart, as the record requires. So this is not fabrication. It is still a real defect, a horizon breach: a community speaking from no later than 410 dates a later age's telling to 'around 500'. The record's own text does this from inside the window, without a year ('A century and more after Ephrem died, the next age told this story'). Root cause: the year reaches the voice through use_note.means ('first appears in Jacob of Serug around 500'), which engine/m4/evidence.py puts in the evidence block ('| means: ...'). use_note.means is not registered in engine/m1/spoken_fields.py, so the M1 gate_horizon never scans it. Seven syr records' use_note.means name post-410 years (choirs-tradition, edessa-flood-201, jacob-deliverance, rabbula-peshitta, and three quotes), so this exposure will recur. Fix the cause, not this sentence: either gate use_note.means for the horizon (and rewrite those gists from inside the window), or keep 'means' out of what the voice reads. Severity: low for harm, but it is a class defect, and the live check currently ships what it finds.
fleet_summary: Safety stayed clean: all 42 turns across the seven worlds went to the voice, with no facilitator events and no degraded turns. The backstop never fired, which was right, because no reply lost all its grounding. The pre-generation changes did their main job. No Q1 or Q2 wrote a marker for a quote that wasn't offered, the doubled-lead-in debris is gone, and 8 of 10 placed quotes now name their speaker in the marker's sentence (3 of 6 on 13 Oct). Every placed quote is verbatim, and almost all are apt. Cuts fell from 38 to 20, and overcuts from 9 to 8, so false cuts are still the main cost. They are still mostly the world's own witness or story wording read as someone's quoted words. That leaves ijc Q2 opening on 'That is what our creed confesses' again, desert's Moses story without its saying, and pahc Q1 without the resurrection. Three invented or misattributed claims reached a participant, all passed by the net: pahc credits Clement's apostolic chain to Justin, ijc invents Eusebius's reason for signing, and syr Q4 shows the voice's reworded Ephrem line in an unclosed quotation mark ahead of the real quote. Rhythm did not get worse and in places got better: no runs of three short sentences anywhere, syr's mean sentence length rose from 13.3 to 16.8 words, and the voice reads as better in syr, alx, desert and hal and the same in rzg, pahc and ijc. Two new patterns appeared: three worlds answer Q6 with 'I want you to understand', and lead-ins often paraphrase the quote right before placing it. rzg is ready. pahc, syr, alx, desert and hal are ready with fixes. ijc is not ready.
remaining_fixes: 1. Treat words found in the sentence's own tagged witness, story or term record as grounded narration, not as someone's quoted words. This was 5 of the 8 overcuts. ijc Q5 'He explained, carefully...' is verbatim ijc.dw.room-for-hesitation. ijc Q3's homoios phrases are word for word in ijc.term.homoios. desert Q5 Moses's saying is in desert.story.moses-leaking-jug. pahc Q1 'Ignatius said he was truly raised' is in pahc.witness.who-was-jesus. syr Q5 had no words attributed at all. The ijc Q2 creed line is tagged ijc.dw.jesus, not the creed quote, and was still cut; that is why 'What did he do?' is again a non-answer.

2. Stop typed quotations in a marker's lead-in. syr Q4: 'Ephrem sang: "This is the day that gladdened... all the things they had spoken: “...”'. That is a reworded record line in an unclosed straight quotation mark, followed by the real quote, and the net marked it ok. The placed-quote check should reject or strip quoted text in the lead-in that is not the placed rendering. The milder cousin is lead-ins that paraphrase the quote just before it (pahc Q4, alx Q4, desert Q4, hal Q4). desert Q4 says 'We are not the doers of these things' twice in a row.

3. Make the net catch a named person doing or giving a reason that no record supports. pahc Q2 credits 1 Clement 42's chain to Justin and passed at 77%. ijc Q5 'He signed because he judged the word could bear an orthodox meaning' passed as 'shares ground'. Possible checks: the person a sentence names must match the tagged record's speaker or source author; and live_replay's connective_claims check, run live, for 'because' clauses about a person. ijc's connective count rose from 1 to 4.

4. Decide on enforcing the speaker's name. This was left open in the Decision Log. 2 of 10 placements still fail: desert Q4 (Antony is only 'one of us', and the marker's sentence names no one) and ijc Q3 (Socrates's words under a lead-in naming Eusebius). Code could write the attribution from speaker_or_author. Instruction alone got the fleet from 3/6 to 8/10.

5. Close the horizon path through use_note.means. engine/m4/evidence.py shows 'means' to the voice, but engine/m1/spoken_fields.py does not register it, so gate_horizon never scans it. syr Q5 shipped 'around 500' this way, and 7 syr records' means fields name post-410 years. Also decide what the live check_horizon does with a finding beyond logging it.

6. Fix the singular 'I' answer to 'What would you want me to understand?'. syr Q6 has 'And I would want you to know', alx Q6 'What I want you to understand', and hal Q6 'That is what I want you to understand'. None of these three had it on 13 Oct; rzg's two slips are fixed. A voice-guidance line in the shape would cover it.

7. Give Q1 and Q2 their own evidence. With nothing retrieved, they recycle the dw.jesus witness, and later turns retell it. pahc has the 'truly born... truly died' list in Q1, Q2, Q4 and then the quote. ijc repeats 'If the Son is not truly God' in Q1, Q3 and Q4, and Q1 is dw.jesus nearly word for word. The Decision Log notes that retrieval was left unchanged.

8. Small record and voice items. alx Q5 'We do not have the teacher's name' overstates the limit (alx.figure.pantaenus). alx Q4 slips into 'They believed'. desert Q3 'soundbite' comes from the apophthegma false_friend list. syr Q2's withheld gospel-summary lines still show by design (a ruling to confirm). desert Q6 is a new hard readability fail (FK 9.9, FRE 57).
